info.name: Kick - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description:
The KICK wordmark glows neon green. Translucent navigation and chat
rails light up along the edges that face the player. Stream information
and About panels fade into the grid, and the chat composer, search,
menus, and dialogs use matching glass surfaces. Stream and category
artwork gets a green edge on hover or keyboard focus. Active tabs and
channel rows use green accents to show where you are.
